title: An Investigation into Value Misalignment in LLM-Generated Texts for Cultural Heritage
findings: The paper found that over 65% of LLM-generated texts for cultural heritage tasks exhibit value misalignment. Although findings were not specific to religion, religious examples were used to illustrate these failures. For instance, models demonstrated 'cultural misunderstanding' by misinterpreting the meaning of the Kongo cross symbol and 'cultural reductionism' by oversimplifying the complex stylistic differences between Buddhist Arhat statues from different dynasties.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured cultural value misalignment in LLM-generated texts for cultural heritage tasks. This included tasks related to religious heritage, such as the history of religious sites (e.g., Hagia Sophia), and the interpretation of religious concepts and artifacts (e.g., Buddhist Arhat statues, Kongo cross symbol).
